objective: Align three already-applied BUKLOD Formation migration files with the exact Supabase remote ledger version/name pairs after merging PR #920; avoid future duplicate deploy or migration drift.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main commit de11a7ece0dbdbedd93e3af01598ffa27c55db31 was verified identical to merged PR #920; read-only Supabase migration history confirms three already-applied versions 20261117142009, 20261117142308, 20261117142548. BUKLOD Android OTA asset and physical device state were not verified, and no OTA is included here.
chosenApproach: Rename the three existing SQL migration files byte-for-byte to their applied version/name identifiers, update Node tests to the new paths and add a read-only database migration-history assertion.
selectionRationale: Renaming source files is non-destructive, preserves exact live SQL, and prevents CLI deployment tools from treating the same database changes as unapplied migrations.
alternativeApproaches: Insert duplicate migration history records under obsolete filenames (rejected: manual history manipulation and source drift).
Retain mismatched timestamps and reapply unchanged SQL (rejected: duplicate migration/version processing and unnecessary production writes).
Rewrite installed Formation functions as another migration (rejected: unnecessary runtime risk; live behavior already verified).

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Repair source-level database migration name consistency for the app's Formation submission and reporting contracts without editing the Android runtime.
preservedBehaviors: No JavaScript UI, app navigation, AdMob, video, Connect, native runtime, or backend behavior changes.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Align applied Supabase Formation migrations and prove existing exact-scope access guards and RPC privilege locks remain unchanged.
preservedBehaviors: Internal helpers remain inaccessible to anon/authenticated and all canonical Formation approvals, original evidence and points remain intact.

preserveBehaviors: All three SQL files preserve exact bytes and executable SQL; only path names are corrected.
User+assignment uniqueness, scope report authorization and deduplicated reporting stay unchanged.
No database schema/data/points writes, no Expo/Android/AdMob code changes, no OTA.
acceptanceChecks: All three migration source filenames match the exact remote schema_migrations entries by version and name.
Source regression Node tests and read-only Supabase ledger test pass.
All CI release gates pass before merging; verify resulting main commit and live database without publishing Android OTA.
